videos.title: Intermediate Egret Hunting Behavior
videos.description: An Intermediate Egret observed in stationary hunting posture on a rock in mid-stream rapids during monsoon season. The characteristic S-shaped neck and motionless stance are remarkable.

videos.title: Waterfowl Flock Behavior
videos.description: Waterfowl swimming in calm water zones at the edge of rapids. They maintain consistent spacing while exhibiting group behavior.

videos.title: Great Cormorant at Jungnangcheon
videos.description: A Great Cormorant diving to catch fish, then spreading its wings to dry - a distinctive behavior of this species.

videos.title: Raccoon Dog Family
videos.description: Wildlife encounters are possible even in urban streams. Young raccoon dogs were observed near the walking trail.

videos.title: Frogs at the Stream
videos.description: The urban stream maintains an environment where amphibians can thrive.

videos.title: Common Moorhen
videos.description: A small-bodied Common Moorhen with black plumage swimming at the edge of rapids, engaging in foraging activities.

videos.title: Grey Heron
videos.description: A large Grey Heron standing motionless at the water's edge, striking prey with lightning speed.

videos.title: Snake at the Stream
videos.description: A snake observed along the Jungnangcheon waterfront, demonstrating the biodiversity of urban streams.

videos.title: Namsan-Bukaksan Cycling Route
videos.description: A representative cycling route through downtown Seoul. Experience nature within the city.

videos.title: Seoul Mountain Panorama
videos.description: A beautiful panorama of mountains surrounding Seoul. Namsan, Bukhansan, Dobongsan, Suraksan, and Bulamsan at a glance.

videos.title: Cat at Bukhansan
videos.description: A cat observed near a temple at Bukhansan. A space where wildlife and feral cats coexist.

videos.title: Jungheungsa Temple
videos.description: The historic Jungheungsa Temple at Bukhansan. A space where nature and culture harmonize.

videos.title: Spider at Bukhansan
videos.description: A spider observed in Bukhansan forest. An important predator in the ecosystem.

videos.title: Dobongsan Rock Formations
videos.description: The unique rock formations of Dobongsan. Jayunbong and Geobukbawi are impressive.

videos.title: Clouds at Unaksan
videos.description: Beautiful cloud scenery at Unaksan. Various forest ecosystems can be observed at high altitude.

videos.title: Bird Sounds at Soyosan
videos.description: Various bird sounds at Soyosan. A mountain where the habitat possibility of the endangered leopard cat has been researched.

videos.title: Insects at Soyosan
videos.description: Various insects observed at Soyosan. A region rich in biodiversity.

videos.title: Mountain Frog
videos.description: A frog inhabiting a mountain valley stream. Lives between water and land.

videos.title: Mountain Katydid
videos.description: A katydid commonly seen in mountain forest areas. Easy to observe from summer to autumn.

videos.title: Mountain Beetle
videos.description: A nocturnal predator, the red-headed cardinal beetle. Plays an important role in forest ecosystems.
